data: Microsoft's fiscal 2023 (the year ended June 30, 2023) produced revenue of about $211.9 billion, gross profit of about $146.1 billion, and operating income of about $88.5 billion. That works out to a gross margin of roughly 69% (146.1 / 211.9 ≈ 68.9%) and an operating margin of roughly 42% (88.5 / 211.9 ≈ 41.8%). Cost of revenue was around $65.8 billion. For context, revenue grew about 7% from $198.3 billion in fiscal 2022, while operating income rose about 6% from $83.4 billion. These figures come from my recollection of Microsoft's reported 10-K results rather than a live lookup, so check them against the filing if you need exact numbers.
